title: Adrenaline
description: This mod adds the new Adrenaline item to Minecraft, the Adrenaline item can be used to add effects to entities and players alike.
body: The Adrenaline mod is a simple mod made in MCreator for Forge 1.20.1 that adds a new item called **Adrenaline** which inflicts effects onto any entity upon usage. By right clicking while holding the item, you can give yourself the provided effects with the item, but if you hit a mob with it, It gives them the effects. The effects given are: **Saturation I**, **Speed I**, and **Resistance II**.
